source_title: 호드 갤길 영포티 전탱 길드추방당함 ㅋㅋ
subtitle: 줄파락 대장 도안 실수 루팅 → '후회하게 해줌' 협박 파탈 → 길드 추방 엔딩

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
앗, 안투술 대장 도안이
획귀인지 몰랐어요!
2시간 거래 되니까 드릴게요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder diagonal shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). Framed over the large foreground shoulder and back of the head of the furious Orc Warrior tank on the lower-right (steel kite shield on left arm, 1H sword at hip). In the background on the lower-left, the Human Warlock girl (dark purple hood, jet-black twintails, violet eyes, imp doll sitting on floor) bows frantically with waterfall anime tears, holding out a rolled cream parchment blueprint scroll with both hands. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, leaving generous pure #FFFFFF white headroom across top 38%.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
빨리 내놔라.
안 그러면 진짜
후회하게 해줌.

Positioned cleanly on the right half facing left, the Orc Warrior tank (green orc hood, crimson eyes, spiky red pauldrons) stomps forward aggressively, pointing a compact 1H steel sword forward and slamming her sturdy steel kite shield with a menacing scowl, dark heavy brow shadows, and dark speed lines. cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
드린다는데 말이 좀...
어, 진짜 파탈해요?!
30분 기다려서 왔는데!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the rage-quitting tank on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). On the lower-right, the Orc Warrior tank turns away with an arrogant petulant huff, channeling a glowing cyan-blue Hearthstone vortex pillar that swirls around her boots (steel kite shield and 1H sword strapped to her back); on the lower-left, the Warlock clutches her blueprint in horrified disbelief! cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
외부인도 모셔놓고 뭐냐!
당장 돌아와서 진행해!
...아니 거기서 접종을?!

같이 접종하셨네요...
